text:
Paula (PM): Heads-up for design crit: multiple customers told support the Usage page "looks busy" and they can't find the invoice quickly. Proposal: introduce a slim 'compact ledger' and a persistent invoice affordance in the header. Thoughts?
Ivy (Design): Compact ledger reduces cognitive load for teams with many projects. We should add a clear primary CTA: 'Download invoice (PDF)'. Secondary per-row action: 'Download usage (CSV)'.
Diego (Analytics): Quick number: header invoice clicks are 2.3x row clicks. If the header CTA is visible above the fold, downloads and fewer support tickets follow.
Omar (Frontend): Implementation notes: sticky header CTA is straightforward. Per-row CSV buttons need roving tabindex to avoid one-tab-per-action. Also large lists require virtualized rows to keep perf good.
Ivy (Design): Accessibility nits: scope switch copy should read "Viewing: Organization 00All projects" -> maybe "Viewing: Organization 00(All projects)"? It must announce in screen readers the change.
ui-bot: Tip: add `aria-live="polite"` on scope updates and wrap the scope controls in `role="region" aria-label="Billing scope"`.
Paula (PM): Token vs USD toggle: customers are split. Suggest we default by role (developers -> tokens, billing-admin -> USD) and show microcopy "Saved preference" when they change it.
Diego (Analytics): We'll backfill telemetry to validate defaults. Also request an experiment: default tokens vs default USD for 2 weeks.
Ivy (Design): Chart placement: small multiples (mini charts per project) are best for 2-6 projects. For >6 projects show an aggregate chart with an expand-to-compare control. Each mini-chart needs `aria-label` like "Project X 0030-day spend".
Omar (Frontend): For aria we'll add `role="img" aria-label="Project X 0030-day spend 00trend: increasing"` to SVG wrappers. For sparklines use canvas in long lists to avoid DOM bloat.
Paula (PM): Copy tweak: change ambiguous "Download" to explicit "Download invoice (PDF)" and row action to "Download usage (CSV)". Users confused which format they'd get.
Ivy (Design): Spacing: compact ledger rows should use 8px vertical rhythm, project name left-aligned with 16px gutter, and sparkline width ~44px. Per-row icons 24px target.
Omar (Frontend): Focus states: `.row-action:focus { outline: 3px solid #005fcc; border-radius: 4px; }` and ensure 4.5:1 contrast on segmented controls.
ui-bot: Checklist generated: ["Header: 'Download invoice (PDF)' visible + last billed date", "Scope switch: role=region + aria-live", "Token/USD segmented control + saved pref copy", "Per-row 'Download usage (CSV)' icon with tooltip", "Adaptive charts: small multiples <=6 else aggregate", "Sparklines: canvas or server-side SVG for perf", "Roving tabindex for row actions", "Contrast & keyboard focus checks"]
Diego (Analytics): One more ask: include a tiny metadata line under the CTA: "Latest billed: Apr 2026" so users know which billing period the PDF covers.
Ivy (Design): Good call. I'll add that to mocks and include a11y annotations.
Paula (PM): Action items: Ivy update Figma, Omar prototype keyboard nav & sparklines perf options, Diego run the role-default experiment, I'll update the PRD copy. Quick review tomorrow 10:30am.
Ivy (Design): I'll post updated frames and ping here when ready. :memo:
Paula (PM): Thanks everyone, resolving for now.
